conservative_admission_observation.interpretation: A prototype-only VLA need not execute a runtime entry effect. The current profile intentionally rejects any modeled variable parameter type, so this is conservative admission, not evidence of an accepted mismatch.

findings.conclusion: Original types are checked before declaration coalescing. Pointer prototype followed by VLA definition, reverse redeclaration and local-header VLA definition reject in real public-entry probes.

Static review confirms the record parameter pointer flag is restored before collect triggers original-type admission. The immutable original declaration is used for expected receipt binding. Existing owner regression covers this path; this independent review did not duplicate that native test.

Reader matches the translator top-level FunctionDecl inventory. Missing/duplicate bindings fail coverage. Nested function prototypes and local VLA typedefs are not silently skipped into a successful bundle; the public migration rejects them with E_C_LOCAL in the probes.

Canonical variable arrays are rejected; pointer/array element types recurse with a 64-depth ceiling and unknown categories reject. Direct VLA, sizeof(VLA), typeof(VLA), comma and multiply-by-zero effectful bounds rejected. No accepted runtime-effect omission was found in the finite probes.
Static review found compiler/libclang/AST hash, version, argv, cwd, declaration coverage and captured dependency revalidation bindings intact. No claimed generic toolchain-trust vulnerability.

Two focused fixture executions confirmed exec preserves process group and AS/FSIZE limits, and normal completion/timeout clean same-group descendants. These fixture tests qualify the process mechanism only, not compiler semantics.

finite_test_limits: Three accepted positive controls were frontend migrations only; no generated Rust/native equivalence execution was added by this review.
Two GNU typeof NULL-array dereference/index exploration cases are retained but excluded from the defined-input-effect denominator; their rejection is not used as a C equivalence claim.
The per-phase 35/30-second subprocess budgets are not a whole-project migration deadline.
No complete suite, benchmark, physical device run or general soundness proof was performed.

nonblocking_scalability_observation.analysis: For N such TUs, this causes about 2N full-project revalidations, each iterating configurations: O(N^2) TU-revalidation work. This is static cost analysis only; no timing study or measured performance regression is claimed.
nonblocking_scalability_observation.code: original_parameter_types invokes verify_capture before and after each pointer-bearing TU read

scope: Independent read-only review of c_parameter_types.py and CTranslator integration, with small C/native and public migration admission probes. Not the integrated 76c928ac validation and not original 108 evidence.
